sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “LLMs Text Generator”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload the ai-content-guide-llms-text-generator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

Setup

  1. Go to the ‘llms.txt generator’ menu item in your admin dashboard
  2. Configure your settings on the Content Settings tab
  3. Review File Settings for delivery method
  4. Click ‘Save Settings’
  5. Click ‘Regenerate Now’ to create your llms.txt file
  6. NEW: Use the ‘Launch llmstxt.in’ button for direct file generation and advanced tools
  7. Verify your file is accessible at yoursite.com/llms.txt
sections.faq:
What is llms.txt?

llms.txt is a proposed standard file format, similar to robots.txt, that helps AI systems better understand website content. It provides a structured way for website owners to present their most important content to Large Language Models (LLMs). Learn more at llmstxt.org.

Will this improve my search engine rankings?

llms.txt primarily targets AI systems rather than traditional search engines. While it may not directly affect your traditional SEO rankings, it can improve how your content appears in AI-generated responses, which is becoming increasingly important as AI-powered search grows.

Does this work with my SEO plugin?

Yes! The plugin integrates seamlessly with popular SEO plugins including:
* Yoast SEO
* Rank Math
* All in One SEO
* SEOPress

It respects your SEO settings, excluding content marked as “noindex” and using your meta descriptions for better content summaries.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. The plugin is designed for performance:
* Files are generated in the background
* Served efficiently using WordPress rewrite rules
* Minimal database queries
* No impact on frontend page load times

How often is the llms.txt file updated?

The file is automatically updated:
* When you publish or update content
* When you change plugin settings
* You can also manually regenerate it anytime from the admin panel

Can I customize what’s included in the llms.txt file?

Absolutely! You have full control over:
* Which post types to include (posts, pages, custom post types)
* Which taxonomies to include (categories, tags, custom taxonomies)
* Maximum number of posts per type
* Custom introduction text
* Additional custom content

What’s the difference between llms.txt and llms-full.txt?

  • llms.txt: A concise overview of your most important content
  • llms-full.txt: A comprehensive version with more detailed content (optional)

Both follow the llms.txt specification but serve different use cases.

Is this plugin compatible with caching plugins?

Yes, the plugin works with all major caching plugins. The llms.txt file is served via WordPress rewrite rules and doesn’t interfere with caching mechanisms.

Does this plugin collect any data?

No. This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All processing happens locally on your server, and the generated files contain only the public content you choose to include.

How do I verify my llms.txt file is working?

  1. Visit yoursite.com/llms.txt in your browser
  2. Check the plugin’s status dashboard for file accessibility
  3. Use the built-in preview feature in the admin panel
